## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- AdvancedRegressionEngine — Kernel Ridge Regression
- 1. RBF kernel fits nonlinear function (sin) with MSE < 0.1
- 2. Linear kernel degenerates to ridge regression
- 3. Higher alpha → more regularization → smoother (higher MSE)
- AdvancedRegressionEngine — GMM
- 4. Recovers 2 clusters from well-separated Gaussian data
